questions.q: What two habits mainly build wealth according to the book?
a: Living below means and investing wisely
questions.why: The text states wealth comes from living below means and investing wisely.

questions.q: Which example illustrates creating luck through hard work?
a: Jerry Weintraub calling Elvis's manager daily
questions.why: The book cites Jerry Weintraub's daily calls to Elvis as a luck‑making example.

questions.q: What is the main reason debt hinders wealth building?
a: It forces monthly payments that cut savings
questions.why: Debt requires payments that reduce the money available to save and invest.

questions.q: Which principle is NOT mentioned in the book's wealth lessons?
questions.why: The book lists saving, investing, and lending, not spending all income.

questions.q: What does the author suggest about 'luck' in wealth creation?
a: It can be manufactured through opportunity
questions.why: The text says luck can be manufactured by creating opportunities.
